text: At 65', Redmond Rovers initiated a pressing trigger by increasing press intensity from 0.82 to 1.0 and raising their line height from 0.78 to 0.9, executing a higher defensive line to compress Ironvale Athletic’s playing space [#1190]. Complemented by a marked rise in directness of play from 0.48 to 0.63, this transition from build-up to quick vertical progression doubled Rovers’ box touches (5 to 10) and significantly increased their xG from 0.25 to 0.91, showing an effective overload in attacking phases [#1190]. Despite a reduction in possession from 63.1% to 45.8%, the field tilt toward Ironvale’s defensive third rose from 60.0% to 80.6%, indicating territorial dominance during Rovers’ direct pressing sequences [#1190]. This strategic shift disrupted Ironvale’s low block and vertical passing threat, as reflected in their xG plummeting from 1.06 to 0.16 and reduced counter-attacking effectiveness post-change [#1190].
